manhattan-penthouse.title: Manhattan Penthouse
manhattan-penthouse.description: A stunning penthouse renovation in the heart of Manhattan. This project transformed a dated space into a contemporary luxury residence with panoramic views of Central Park and the New York skyline.
manhattan-penthouse.challenge: The client wanted to maximize views while creating distinct living spaces in an open concept floor plan. Additionally, integrating smart home technology without compromising the luxurious aesthetic was a priority.
manhattan-penthouse.solution: We designed a flexible living space with movable glass partitions, allowing the client to adjust between open entertainment areas and private retreats. Custom furniture was designed to complement the skyline views, and state-of-the-art smart home systems were seamlessly integrated into the architectural details.

testimonial.text: FeatherWood transformed our penthouse beyond our expectations. They understood our vision and created a space that feels both luxurious and livable. The attention to detail is remarkable.

coastal-villa.title: Coastal Villa
coastal-villa.description: A breathtaking coastal villa that harmoniously blends indoor and outdoor living. This oceanfront property features expansive glass walls that frame the Pacific Ocean views and a design that celebrates the natural beauty of the California coastline.
coastal-villa.challenge: Creating a space that could withstand coastal elements while maintaining a light, open feel and providing privacy from neighboring properties.
coastal-villa.solution: We utilized durable, marine-grade materials throughout the exterior and selected salt-air resistant finishes for the interior. Strategic landscaping and architectural elements provide privacy without compromising views, and retractable glass walls allow for seamless indoor-outdoor flow.

testimonial.text: Our Malibu home is absolutely everything we dreamed of and more. FeatherWood captured the essence of coastal living while creating a sophisticated retreat that's perfect for both relaxation and entertaining.

tech-headquarters.title: Tech Headquarters
tech-headquarters.description: A forward-thinking headquarters for a leading technology company that balances innovation with employee wellbeing. The space features collaboration zones, focus areas, and amenities designed to foster creativity and productivity.
tech-headquarters.challenge: Creating a workplace that reflects the company's innovative culture while accommodating multiple work styles and promoting employee wellness and collaboration.
tech-headquarters.solution: We designed a flexible workspace with diverse environments tailored to different activities and work preferences. Biophilic design elements, including living walls and natural light, promote wellbeing, while cutting-edge technology is integrated throughout to support hybrid collaboration.

mountain-retreat.title: Mountain Retreat
mountain-retreat.description: A luxurious mountain home that embraces its natural surroundings while providing modern comfort. This retreat combines rustic architectural elements with contemporary design to create a warm, inviting space for both intimate family gatherings and entertaining.
mountain-retreat.challenge: Creating a design that would withstand the harsh mountain climate while maximizing mountain views and incorporating natural elements in a contemporary way.
mountain-retreat.solution: We selected materials known for their durability in extreme temperatures, including insulated glass and thermally broken window frames. The home's orientation takes advantage of the spectacular mountain vistas, while a thoughtful material palette of locally-sourced stone and reclaimed timber creates a sense of place.

features.description: Heated terraces and a covered outdoor kitchen allow for year-round enjoyment of the mountain setting

features.title: Custom Wine Cellar
features.description: Temperature-controlled wine storage with custom racking system and tasting area

features.title: Home Theater
features.description: Professional-grade audio-visual system with soundproofing and comfortable seating

testimonial.text: Our mountain home exceeds all expectations. FeatherWood brilliantly balanced rustic elements with clean, modern design. It's both a showpiece and a comfortable family retreat that we'll enjoy for generations.
testimonial.author: Robert & Ann K.

boutique-hotel.title: Boutique Hotel
boutique-hotel.description: A distinctive boutique hotel that captures Miami's vibrant energy and artistic spirit. The design creates a sophisticated urban oasis with bold colors, luxurious textures, and custom installations from local artists.
boutique-hotel.challenge: Transforming a historic building into a luxury boutique hotel while preserving its architectural integrity and creating spaces that would appeal to design-conscious travelers.
boutique-hotel.solution: We carefully restored the building's historic facade while completely reimagining the interior. Each of the 42 guest rooms features a unique design theme inspired by Miami's diverse cultural influences, and public spaces serve as both social hubs and showcases for local art.

urban-loft.title: Urban Loft
urban-loft.description: A sophisticated urban loft that celebrates the industrial heritage of its building while providing sleek, contemporary living spaces. Raw architectural elements are juxtaposed with refined furnishings and carefully curated art pieces.
urban-loft.challenge: Transforming a raw industrial space into a refined yet characterful home while respecting the building's historic architecture and accommodating the client's extensive art collection.
urban-loft.solution: We preserved key architectural elements including exposed brick walls, timber beams, and concrete floors, while introducing new elements that create visual continuity and a gallery-like backdrop for the client's art collection. Custom storage solutions and thoughtful space planning maximize functionality.

testimonial.text: FeatherWood created a home that perfectly balances industrial character with refined detailing. They understood exactly how I wanted to live in the space and designed solutions that accommodate both my daily lifestyle and entertainment needs.
